Wondering how the AC works in NYC? I'm in Australia where summer will deliver 98-105F days for weeks at a time. At least residentially (obviously commercial machines are more powerful), for most houses, it doesn't matter if you put the AC on 77F or 70F eitherway - the air con doesn't magically get more powerful just because you set the temperature lower. If you were already asking it to turn 98F air into 79F air and then maintain it, then that AC unit is already working at Max Capacity to achieve that. It's not drawing a tonne more power (if any), just because you set the temp lower - in all likelyhood the thing is just going to work at Max capacity to try and produce that great a difference regardless .
